senses.gloss:
मोटकः,
 
-कम् [मुट्-ण्वुल्] A pill. 
-कम् A couple of broken blades of Kuśa grass given at a Śrāddha (भग्नकुशपत्रद्वयम्).

मोटनम्,
 
-मोटनकम् Crushing, pressing, grinding, breaking. 
-नः Wind, air.

Silent involuntary expression of affection towards an absent lover, as when a woman, her mind being taken up by her lover, scratches the ear &c. when he is remembered or talked of; it is thus defined by उज्ज्बलमणि :--कान्तस्मरणवार्तादौ हृदि तद्भावभावतः । प्राकठ्यसभिलाषस्य मोट्टायितमुदीर्यते; see [[S. D. 141]] also; सद्यो मोट्टायितमधुरिमोल्लासभङ्गीविधाता [[Ud. S. 35.]]
